body_markdown:
Søren Steenberg Jensen, CEO of Hafnia, was recently interviewed on the Complexio Podcast.


During the conversation, Søren shared his perspectives on AI adoption, the development of Complexio, and how Stevie is being introduced to more parts of the organization.


The discussion also covered the importance of security, governance and change management when adopting AI.


The full podcast episode can be listened to here:[https://open.spotify.com/episode/38y6J81IPejPhwwbxiNzUP?si=JVvVStk7T72FMWzli48nRg](https://open.spotify.com/episode/38y6J81IPejPhwwbxiNzUP?si=JVvVStk7T72FMWzli48nRg) .
